text: Camp fires - he says he was flown out after 2-3 days of seeing the hundreds of camp fires.
researchNotes: Third-person report — "he says" — so paraphrase by the archive's rule, though the figure is his. Answers two tier-1 probes at once (how many nights of campfires; how long after them he was flown out): 2–3 days for both. Read against his Camp Zama date of 3 Sept, the campfire nights fall around 23–26 August 1965. Not to be confirmed by suggesting a number.
